candidate_source_binding: the explicit production-path A/C plumbing, six-mode gate, custody closure, tests, and this predeclaration must be committed and pushed together before the first production-topology candidate performance sample

primitive_authorization.scope: count-matched primitive only; authorizes this separate explicit full-path continuation gate, not default activation

scope.runtime_path: explicit Metal W8 MLP-to-Stack3 boundary plus fused tail-head v1

production_mapping.changed_scope: the recurrent dispatch inside the initial Stack3 and each of five MLP-to-Stack3 boundary transactions
production_mapping.unchanged_scope: all other kernels, dispatch counts, barriers, encoders, command buffers, commits, waits, state publication, full attention and KV, prefill, tail MLP/head, exact F32 rerank, and host transfer topology
production_mapping.fixed_shape_lock: H=1024/KH=16/VH=16/KD=128/VD=128/conv=4 on both Rust and Objective-C++ boundaries

changed_body_metric.per_arm_statistic: even median of the two A or two C teacher receipt values

end_to_end_metric.field: profile.tpot_ms from the eight free candidate receipts
end_to_end_metric.per_block_statistic: even median of two A values and even median of two C values
end_to_end_metric.pooled_statistic: even median of all four A values and even median of all four C values
end_to_end_metric.clearly_negative_block_definition: C-over-A improvement at or below -0.50 percent

custody.publication: each raw receipt is create-new and published only after successful end-custody verification

classification.if_quiet_host_fails: complete the fixed schedule once only as non-formal diagnostic evidence
classification.explicit_continuation_acceptance: exactness, path, custody, fixed-schedule and both performance gates pass; permits retaining only the explicit opt-in C route
classification.formal_promotion_acceptance: explicit continuation acceptance plus strict quiet-host preflight; still requires a separate default-activation decision
classification.failure_action: archive raw receipts and a rejection summary, then revert the production C plumbing and six-mode harness while preserving primitive evidence and this predeclaration

cross_runtime_rule.after_acceptance: refresh same-host same-prompt same-128-token greedy diagnostic comparisons for llama.cpp and omnimind-ai/OmniInfer; separate llama.cpp core timing from OmniInfer gateway/orchestration wall time
cross_runtime_rule.ascend_omni_ai_npu_project: cross-hardware service metrics only, never a same-hardware engine claim
